title: Replace text attributes in target text in anonymization mode
body: Extracting the anonymized text would be much easier if the text attributes in the target text were replaced with e.g. *firstname:unknown*. Right now, one has to iterate over the edges and replace text attributes when labels are found.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
e.g:
```

{
  "source": [
    {"id": "s0", "text": "Alice "},
    {"id": "s1", "text": "and "},
    {"id": "s2", "text": "Bob "},
    {"id": "s3", "text": "went "},
    {"id": "s4", "text": "to "},
    {"id": "s5", "text": "Paris "},
    {"id": "s6", "text": ". "},
    {"id": "s7", "text": "Alice's "},
    {"id": "s8", "text": "wallet "},
    {"id": "s9", "text": "was "},
    {"id": "s10", "text": "stolen "},
    {"id": "s11", "text": ". "}
  ],
  "target": [
    {"id": "t0", "text": "Alice "},
    {"id": "t1", "text": "and "},
    {"id": "t2", "text": "Bob "},
    {"id": "t3", "text": "went "},
    {"id": "t4", "text": "to "},
    {"id": "t5", "text": "Paris "},
    {"id": "t6", "text": ". "},
    {"id": "t7", "text": "Alice's "},
    {"id": "t8", "text": "wallet "},
    {"id": "t9", "text": "was "},
    {"id": "t10", "text": "stolen "},
    {"id": "t11", "text": ". "}
  ],
...
```
Alice should not appear in target if i've labeled her.
